title: Enable Linux Vulkan SM6 target for hardware ray tracing
objective: Implement the project configuration change required for hardware ray tracing on Linux SPEAR packages. Current packages are VULKAN_SM5 because DefaultEngine.ini lacks a LinuxTargetPlatform override, so UE disables Vulkan ray tracing before runtime CVars matter. Add the Linux target settings needed to cook and run as SF_VULKAN_SM6.
instructions: Prefer SM6-only for this hardware RT validation path so the package cannot silently fall back to VULKAN_SM5.

Add the Linux target settings section near the existing WindowsTargetSettings section. Expected setting is TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM6; include bEnableRayTracing=True only if the UE 5.5 Linux target settings supports it as config.
Do not recook, package, run long Unreal jobs, or make Git commits; Tower will route those to Experimenter/Git-master.
Preserve existing flashlight runtime RT controls and crash-safe unsupported-RT guards unless there is a direct conflict.

artifacts: Linux SPEAR hardware RT requires the project to target SF_VULKAN_SM6 under /Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings; current packages were VULKAN_SM5 because DefaultEngine.ini lacked a Linux override and UE BaseEngine.ini defaults Linux to SF_VULKAN_SM5.

expected_outputs: Exact files changed and a concise explanation of why this makes Linux packages target VULKAN_SM6.
Verification commands/results for static config validation.
definition_of_done: DefaultEngine.ini has LinuxTargetPlatform settings that target SF_VULKAN_SM6 for Linux packages.
No unrelated product code, docs, or Git changes are made.
